subject: test(material/slider): Ensure tick marks are rendered correctly (#30317)

hunk_reviews.judgment: The first hunk adds three tests: a private-array existence check, count updates101/11/6/2 and modern tick-element spacing with0.1 tolerance. The300px-minus6px arithmetic and initial x18 belong to the modern MDC fixture. No evidence authorizes changing legacy padding, creating modern tick nodes or substituting these expectations for the historical interval/transform assertions. The three TODO comments are explicitly unexecuted.

The second hunk adds SliderWithTickMarks with showTickMarks:true and an input matSliderThumb under SLIDER_STYLES. The retained historical slider has no thumb-input directive and continues to use tickInterval with gradient transforms. Do not add a modern component/API mirror or alter the existing legacy fixture template.

decision: The complete modern slider patch adds three live tick cases and one SliderWithTickMarks fixture, with no production changes. The tests inspect private _tickMarks counts, active/inactive MDC tick elements and the modern300px track with3px padding; three commented TODOs are not tests. The owned legacy slider exposes tickInterval and renders a historical gradient through .mat-slider-ticks, not one DOM element per tick or an input matSliderThumb. Its auto/set/reset interval cases and three complete tick style/calculation methods remain identical to the authenticated tagged methods. Keep the historical API, DOM and CSS/SCSS; the modern101-element geometry is not its oracle. Actual legacy rendering and supported peer/browser execution remain required.
